#| fig-cap: Network connectivity after sequential immunization, comparing the two strategies.
#| label: fig-netimpact
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 9

targets::tar_read(plotdata_net_impact_profile) |>
  plot_centrality_bar() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc(name = "", option = "light") +
  scale_axis_mpxnyc() +
  scale_x_continuous_mpxnyc("Count of vacicnated community districts") +
  theme_mpxnyc_netimpact(
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(30,30,30,30)),
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(30,30,30,30))
  )
